LabAttempt.title: LabAttempt
LabAttempt.description: A student's virtual 3D physics laboratory or WAEC/NECO practical examination attempt with measurements, graphing slope, error analysis, and AI grading feedback.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the student who performed the practical.

studentName.description: Display name of the student candidate.

experimentId.description: Unique identifier of the physics practical experiment.

experimentTitle.description: Title of the WAEC/NECO/NERDC practical experiment.

category.description: Curriculum domain (Mechanics, Optics, Electricity, Heat, Waves, Magnetism, Modern Physics).

score.description: Practical score awarded out of maxScore.

maxScore.description: Maximum marks obtainable for the practical.

slopeCalculated.description: Best-fit line gradient calculated from the student's plotted graph.

errorPercentage.description: Experimental percentage error relative to theoretical standard.

aiFeedback.description: Automated examiner and AI tutor feedback on precautions, observations, and graph deduction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was recorded (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ClassAssignment.title: ClassAssignment
ClassAssignment.description: A teacher-created physics practical assignment or mock examination task aligned with NERDC, WAEC, and NECO syllabi.

userId.description: The authenticated UID of the teacher/creator.

experimentTitle.description: Title of the assigned practical experiment.

targetAccuracyPercent.description: Maximum allowed experimental error tolerance percentage (1 to 25).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the practical assignment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the assignment was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the assignment was updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/lab_attempts/{attemptId}.description: Stores authenticated student physics practical and mock exam attempts.

/class_assignments/{assignmentId}.description: Stores teacher-created practical assignments and WAEC/NECO readiness tasks.
